Our point of view

Collecting art is
a conversation.

A gallery for looking slowly.

Atelier No. 8 brings together original work by a small, evolving group of contemporary artists. We value practices that reward attention and objects made to endure.

We work closely with artists, price transparently, and help first-time and established collectors alike find work that feels genuinely their own.
